title: A campsite at dusk
checked: Every reachable state checked (8 states, 11 with their data, 12 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 8 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.
The fire never burns while nobody is awake at camp.
rules.path: Take away the fire out guard and it breaks in 3 steps: light the fire, next step, walk to the lake.

rules.says: From lights out, and when the bear comes, every bit of food is in the bear box.
rules.path: Take away the food stowed guard and it breaks in 8 steps: light the fire, next step, douse the fire, walk to the lake, back to the fire, douse the fire, to bed, lights out.
